finding: apply wrapper may splice own rest list before app; app immediately POP_ARGS2 then PUSH each car while walking cdr, finally jump target
hazard: Collecting reserve inserted inside raw PUSH loop would expose partial incoming argument frame; retrying wrapper can repeat mutation
proposedReplacement: New CallInputView cut at Scheme app boundary before inline C pops/expansion, after original evaluation/splice; logical inputs preserved

finding: Current app counts na while pushing, detects >MAX_NB_ARGS, removes pushed args then tail raises limit exception
hazard: No existing count-before-expand descriptor or stable snapshot; two-pass count can change mutable input observations
proposedReplacement: Stable input profile or scan-safe single-read CallArgPacket staging; retain target and spine/prefix roots; preserve invalid-input/error read order

finding: Jump carries opnd/ret/nargs/poll/frame; emitter may overwrite R0 or spare destination, emit block checks, adjust stack then jump
hazard: Late-bound global target lookup also cannot be hoisted across collecting callbacks; reserve at final jump may already follow destructive operand moves
proposedReplacement: Scheme semantic completion emits pre-shuffle CallInputView and final grant/consume region; source producer placement proof remains open

finding: Compile-time reserved counters drive checks; jump inline/direct dispatch may bypass generic rest entry
hazard: Compiler reserved count and passing POLL do not reserve an exclusive physical interval; late poll can invalidate grant
proposedReplacement: Run required collecting checks with complete view first, then final noncollecting grant; specialize exact body/argument contract instead of blanket rest charge

finding: c-make-function converts parameters, generated make-body emits SFUN_ARG stores then SFUN_CALL; BEGIN allocates marker earlier
hazard: Converted SCMOBJ locals and raw outgoing stores are not automatically a complete GC view before ___call
proposedReplacement: Typed NativeCallInputView/root frame before raw stores; preserve conversion order, error/result ABI and same invocation leases

finding: ___call assumes C caller already placed args above fp, builds return marker frame, pops regs and sets target
hazard: Collecting capacity request inside ___call before reconstructing rooted outgoing inputs is not automatically safe
proposedReplacement: Preflight at staged native caller; keep return-to-C frame construction noncollecting under exact stack lease

finding: Marker allocator uses make_vector before copying proc, source TODO for protecting input; SFUN conversion errors may call Scheme
hazard: Native staging cannot claim safe preflight if marker/proc roots already unprotected
proposedReplacement: Root target before marker allocation, all-domain handles and complete ancestor native root/exit plan; inherited gap stays open

finding: set_heap_msection selects tospace half; prepare leaves two end marker words, writes first link word and starts data chunk
hazard: Raw half-section size overcounts client data; allocating a logical window must not skip uninitialized prefix
proposedReplacement: Grant current hp-to-dataHi offsets after metadata; fresh separate half has 65533 candidate data words by source arithmetic only

finding: Shared msection changes both limits with fudge and 1/4-versus-3/4 split
hazard: Independent heap/stack scalar capacity can double-promise intersecting bytes
proposedReplacement: Grant actual disjoint intervals and guard budget under one layout incarnation, or use separately owned sections

finding: Current scanner/allocation tracks chunk start, markers and initialized allocation prefix
hazard: Publishing an uninitialized gap as a scannable copying chunk is unqualified; collector-copy chunk limits and mutator data bounds are different roles
proposedReplacement: Cursor-window lease leaves hp unchanged; write complete objects and advance only initialized prefix; chunk transitions must join plan or be excluded

finding: heap_limit can take free msection or get next section, prepare new hp/limits, or signal GC need
hazard: A ticket for prior hp/layout does not remain valid across this helper even without GC
proposedReplacement: Replace admitted repair path with lease-local noncollecting budget/need-GC check, close lease at full frame before normal collector

finding: stack_limit may allocate/reuse msection and migrate frames/stack break; old section can join free list
hazard: Same GC epoch does not imply unchanged stack interval/cursor or live pointer locations
proposedReplacement: Layout generation changes invalidate unused grants; qualify stack-demand FrameSpec and prohibit migration inside leased shuffle

finding: setup_stack_heap_vmstate flips tospace offset, resets per-PSTATE free list/section/cursors/chunk queues
hazard: Old capacity receipt cannot survive semispace flip/reset; addresses can later repeat
proposedReplacement: Cancel unused grants and settle active constructors before GC, use epoch+layout+serial and reissue against new actual intervals

finding: GC phases/resize/fudge then prepare context, with notification before preparation; TLS binding is separate
hazard: GC interrupt/result alone does not authorize new raw cursor use or stale root access
proposedReplacement: Whole-round result, exact owner/context binding and relocated CallInputView handle reload before new grant or completed packet resume

finding: f3 generic rest source and real Tcl setter -> variadic tcl caller provide zero/one-required four-arg shapes
hazard: Direct specialization/generic slow execution and physical pressure are conditional; no native run receipt
proposedReplacement: Front-load all four/three pair costs plus fallback packet; retain existing single native invocation and nargs=-1 completed-packet resume

finding: alloc_mem_lock protects selected section operations; PSTATE cleanup frees resources before later join result handling
hazard: Allocation lock is not a complete per-call ticket/GC exclusion protocol; unknown stop cannot retire active writer
proposedReplacement: VM canonical reservation records, no GC-critical lock held while waiting, known stop/final-effect evidence before range reclamation
